title: ECOM Build and Deploy Pipeline
content: Automated CI/CD pipeline for ECOM services. Build stage compiles code, runs unit tests, and performs static code analysis. Deploy stage includes deployment to DEV environment, automated integration tests, and optional deployment to UAT. Uses Docker containers for consistent deployment across environments. Pipeline triggers on Git commits to main branch.

title: Kenan Deployment Pipeline
content: Deployment pipeline for Kenan system. Stages include database migration scripts validation, application build with Oracle dependencies, unit and integration testing, and staged deployment to UAT environment. Manual approval required before production deployment. Includes automated rollback capability if health checks fail.

title: ESOM Integration Test Pipeline
content: End-to-end integration testing pipeline for ESOM. Tests complete provisioning workflows including integration with ECOM, Kenan, and NetworkProvisioningService. Uses test data fixtures and mocked external services. Validates workflow state transitions, error handling, and rollback mechanisms. Runs nightly and on-demand.
